1. The service

PineVela is operated by PineVela Ghana ("we", "us" or "our") at pinevela.app. These terms apply to your use of PineVela. If you do not agree to them, do not use the service.

PineVela offers housing-management and marketplace tools for residents, housing managers, staff, sellers and administrators. Access to a feature depends on the account, registration, permissions and service availability that apply to you.

A PineVela account does not by itself establish a tenancy, guarantee housing, authorize employment or approve a seller. Separate housing, employment, purchase and subscription arrangements may apply.
